text:
The Precision & Ease Update

• New Tracking Modes: Choose between Smart, Manual, or Off tracking.
• Precision Marking: Use the double-tick icon to mark progress with instant Undo support.
• Gap Detection: Resume reading easily with our new missing-verse detection.
• Premium Experience: Enjoy refined animations, notifications, and traditional Arabic verse numbering.
• Flexible Reading: Customize your experience with new Arabic fonts and dynamic text sizing.
• Performance: Faster scrolling and smarter contextual bookmarks.

Thank you for choosing Hafiz Pro. Experience the Quran like never before.
